title: Portfolio, registry and correspondence operations
walkthrough:
Each screen has a top bar reading "ANDS Studio" with chips linking to "Dossier manager" and "Guided journey →" (the Registry and Correspondence screens also add a "Portfolio" chip); content sits below in glass-style cards.

On the Portfolio page, under the heading "Portfolio" and the line "Every product dossier in your organisation — module progress, filing gate and fee status at a glance.", you see three summary cards — "Dossiers", "Ready to file", "Blocked" — then one row per dossier: its ID, title, a mini module tower, a gate chip reading "Ready to file" or e.g. "3/5 modules", a fee chip ("Fee paid", "Fee waived", or "Fee due" with an amount), and sometimes a live litigation clock like "NOA: 12d for brand to act". Row links: "Open →" and "Viewer". A button "Export client status report (CSV)" downloads a spreadsheet. With no dossiers you see "No dossiers yet." with a link to the dossier manager.

On the Product registry page ("Product registry"), you click "Register product +" to open a form with fields "Product name", "Dossier ID", "DIN (8 digits)", "Country" and "Drug type", plus the note "New registrations start as Submitted; move them to NOC-Issued and Marketed as Health Canada progresses." An invalid DIN shows "A DIN is exactly 8 digits (e.g. 02248808)". Each registration row shows the DIN (or "DIN pending"), a status chip, and buttons for allowed transitions (e.g. "→ Marketed"). A "Right-to-Sell deadlines" strip notes the annual fee is "due October 1" of the fiscal year and lists per-product due dates (e.g. "due 2025-10-01"), and an "Annual notification checklist" warns it is "Reminder only" — ticks are stored in your browser, not filed.

On the Correspondence page ("Correspondence & notices"), the view is scoped to one dossier: a "Dossier" input with placeholder "e123456" offers a dropdown of existing dossiers (the first is pre-selected and opened automatically), but you can also type an ID freehand; you press "Open" to switch. With nothing selected (e.g. no dossiers yet): "Pick a dossier to see its correspondence, notices and NOA clocks." Three stacked panels follow. "Notice inbox" records notices from Health Canada; if no lifecycle exists you first click "Start lifecycle" with a submission type and received date. Ingesting a notice (button e.g. "Ingest SAL") shows a confirmation naming the logged record and any response window. "Correspondence hub" lists every exchange with direction chips ("HC → sponsor" / "sponsor → HC") and a "Log correspondence +" form. "Form V / NOA register" lists patent allegations with status labels like "NOA served — 45-day action window open", live day-countdown clocks, and buttons "File Form V +", "Serve NOA" and "Record s.6 action".
